title: Service Standards for Utility Line Protection Plans: Contact Windows, Repair Guarantee and Line Replacement Trigger
content:
# Service Standards: Contact Windows, Repair Guarantee and Line Replacement Trigger

Network Management schedule for the Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans.

| Plan | Routine contact window | Emergency contact window | Repair guarantee | Full-replacement break count | Replacement lookback | Own-contractor work reimbursed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Exterior Water Service Line Plan | 48 hours | 12 hours | 180 days | 2 | 730 days | No |
| Bridgewell Exterior Electrical Line Plan | 48 hours | 12 hours | 180 days | 2 | 730 days | No |
| Bridgewell Exterior Sewer and Septic Line Plan | 48 hours | 12 hours | 180 days | 2 | 730 days | No |
| Bridgewell Interior Plumbing and Drainage Plan | 48 hours | 12 hours | 180 days | 0 | 0 days | No |
| Bridgewell Water and Sewer Line Bundle | 48 hours | 12 hours | 180 days | 2 | 730 days | No |
| Bridgewell Total Home Lines Plan | 24 hours | 6 hours | 180 days | 2 | 730 days | No |

## Definitions

- **Routine contact window** — hours within which the contractor contacts the customer on a routine request.
- **Emergency contact window** — hours within which the contractor contacts the customer on an emergency request.
- **Repair guarantee** — calendar days after a completed line repair during which a failure of the same repaired section is a recall, not a new occurrence.
- **Full-replacement break count** — the number of covered breaks on the same line within the lookback at which Bridgewell replaces the line instead of repairing a section; 0 means never.
- **Replacement lookback** — calendar days counted back from the request date for the full-replacement break count; 0 when not applicable.
- **Own-contractor work reimbursed** — whether a repair by a contractor of the customer's choosing is reimbursed.

## Points read from the table

- The Total Home Lines Plan has the shortest contact windows: 24 hours routine and 6 hours emergency, against 48 and 12 hours on every other plan.
- The repair guarantee is 180 days on every plan.
- The Interior Plumbing and Drainage Plan never replaces a whole line for repeat breaks (break count 0, lookback 0 days); every other plan shows a break count of 2 over a 730-day lookback.
- No plan reimburses work by a contractor the customer hires.
